individual-data-points.explanation: Stacked area/bar chart showing median promoter-state frequencies as a continuous function of binned Pol II ChIP-seq signal; this is a trend/distribution representation analogous to a line plot, for which overlaying individual data points across thousands of promoters and many bins would be unreadable, so it is exempt.

Each row of the single-molecule stack already represents an individual DNA molecule's methylation profile, so individual data points (molecules) are directly displayed alongside the summary state-frequency sidebars and percentages.
Same representation as panel A (mouse data): a stacked area/bar chart of median state frequencies across Pol II ChIP-seq bins, exempt like a line/trend plot.
Same representation as panel B (mouse locus): each row is an individual molecule, so individual data are already shown.

Box plot showing distribution of PIC occupancy frequencies; box plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points since they already display the data distribution (and individual outlier points are shown).
Box plot showing distribution of Pol II occupancy frequencies; exempt for the same reason as panel E.
